response.sql: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS baseline FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - oa.baseline AS excess FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.baseline) SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS mean_of_station_avgs, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess FROM above_baseline;
